{"metadata":{"description":"中文文档 (README.zh.md)","id":"gh:1345874826","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tool-normalizer","slug":"merenguesL/dsh-tool-normalizer","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-tool-normalizer"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> An auto-healing layer for model tool calls: it silently fixes the failures that used to cost you a"},{"id":"p2s2","text":" full retry round-trip, and shows you the receipts."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文文档 (README.zh.md)"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Every failed tool call costs a full model round-trip: the error comes back, the model re-reads the e"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ntire conversation context, and tries again. In a large workspace that retry resubmits ~180k input t"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"okens — so a ~5% tool failure rate quietly inflates your token bill by more than 2× on the affected "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"turns, and your agent visibly stumbles every few minutes."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This plugin sits on the `tools/execute` pipeline and repairs the failure before it ever reaches the "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"model: a missing `description` is filled in, a forgotten file read is performed and the edit retried"},{"id":"p6s3","text":", a relative path is resolved, an unrecoverable error gets an actionable hint appended. Measured acr"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"oss 192 real sessions (15,460 tool calls):"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Surfaced error rate fell from **7.95% → 2.20%** (about **72% fewer** visible failures).
- About **"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"82%** of would-be errors were healed automatically (837 healed vs 182 residual).
- Each heal avoids "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"one full-context retransmission (median ~160k input tokens), totaling **~153M tokens** — roughly **1"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"15%** of what the models actually consumed in the same window, i.e. without healing the token spend "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"would have been ~2.2× (estimated: token-meter pressure × skipped round-trips)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"What you get is an agent that stops tripping over its own tool calls — plus a dashboard that proves "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t you get is an agent that stops tripping over its own tool calls — plus a dashboard that proves it:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does for you"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **Fixes calls before they fail** — schema mismatches (`command` → `code`, missing `description`, "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"Markdown fences), Code-Mode inner-call descriptions, relative paths and view ranges.
2. **Retries wh"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"at is safe to retry** — one scoped read-then-retry for guarded file mutations, one bounded range ret"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ry; anchor failures are never retried blindly.
3. **Shows everything** — KPI cards, per-tool and per"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"-category rankings, and a filterable before/after trace, one click away in Settings:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Rankings & root causes | Healing rules |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 📖 Background & Empirical Motivation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In DeepSeek Harness, tool execution reliability is critical for autonomous agent loops. An empirical"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" analysis across **111 persisted sessions** (containing **11,176 total tool invocations**) revealed "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"**543 tool call errors** (a **4.86% error rate** across 53.2% of sessions)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Detailed root-cause analysis identified four primary structural error drivers:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **`INVALID_ARGS` Schema Incompatibilities (13.6%, 74 cases)**:
- The model frequently treats `run"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"_code` as `bash`, supplying `{"command": "..."}` instead of `{"description": "...", "code": "..."}`."},{"id":"p15s3","text":"
- The model frequently omits the required `description` field in `run_code`.
2. **`UNKNOWN_TOOL` Co"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"de-Mode Cognitive Inertia (12.3%, 67 cases)**:
- When Code-Mode is active, only `run_code` is expose"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"d directly to the model. However, the model regularly hallucinates direct tool calls like `read`, `b"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ash`, `write`, or `grep`, which fail immediately with `UNKNOWN_TOOL`.
3. **`CODE_RUN_FAILED` In-Sand"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"box Failures (46.8%, 254 cases)**:
- JavaScript syntax errors caused by multiline shell or Python sc"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ripts nested inside JS template strings with unescaped backticks or newlines.
4. **File System Safet"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"y Policy Violations (5.5%, 30 cases)**:
- Violating DSH's read-before-edit invariant (`FS_NOT_OBSERV"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ED`), editor `view_range` line count out-of-bounds, or using relative paths instead of absolute path"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"`), editor `view_range` line count out-of-bounds, or using relative paths instead of absolute paths."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Production rollout effects (v0.4.0 · 192 sessions / 15,460 calls)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Sessions before the plugin's first activation (7,182 calls, **7.95%** error rate) versus after (8,28"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"9 calls, **2.20%**):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- `INVALID_ARGS` missing-description failures fell from 74 to 2 (outer `RUN_CODE_DESC` plus preempti"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ve `INNER_DESC` heals).
- Inner `description` omissions surfacing as `CODE_RUN_FAILED` fell from 45 "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"to 0 (598 preemptive `INNER_DESC` successes in the plugin log).
- `FS_NOT_OBSERVED` fell from 10 to "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"0 (169 observe-then-retry successes).
- `UNKNOWN_TOOL` halved (71 → 35) but persists: PTC-collapsed "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"calls are denied before the waterfall and stay unobservable to any plugin, so v0.4.0 appends a reiss"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ue hint to those errors instead of silently dropping them.
- Residual `CODE_RUN_FAILED` syntax failu"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"res are semantic breakage no safe rewrite can guess (Python pasted as JS, wrong APIs); v0.4.0 append"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"s a parse-failure hint for those."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Counterfactual upper bound: without the 837 healed successes, the post window would have shown ≈12.3"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"% instead of 2.20%. Token savings sum measured retransmission avoided (token-meter pressure × skippe"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"d round-trips), never a hardcoded constant. Since v0.4.0 the plugin's own nested recoveries are excl"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"uded from interception counts, so the denominator is user-facing calls only."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## 🎯 What Problems `dsh-tool-normalizer` Solves"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`dsh-tool-normalizer` acts as a low-overhead, deterministic safety middleware: normalization and hea"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ling on the `tools/execute` waterfall, statistics in the `tools/result` observer off the dispatch ho"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t path, paired with an integrated Web UI diagnostics dashboard."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Key Features"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- 🛠️ **`run_code` Schema Auto-Healing**:
